name: singlet_ingest_quant_feature_barcode_counting
title: Count feature barcodes (ADT, hashtag, lipid-tag, guide) per cell
description: Matches feature-library read sequences to a feature reference within a stated mismatch tolerance, collapses UMIs per cell and feature, and writes a cell-by-feature molecule count matrix. Use it on feature-library FASTQ after cell barcode correction, with a reference whose tags are pairwise separated. Do not use it for gene reads or to assign samples or guides; call the downstream demultiplexing or perturbation tools on its output.

dataset.description: Dataset handle (.singlet path, URI or workspace handle) whose RNA cell index receives the feature modality.

feature_reference.description: Feature reference TSV: tag sequence, feature name and feature type. Sequences must share one length.

fastq.description: Feature-library FASTQ: R1 and R2 paths, or a directory containing them.

whitelist.description: Corrected cell barcode list from barcode whitelist correction; default is the RNA cell index.

method.description: Counting method. mismatch_index is the default; kite and citeseq_count are comparators.

mismatch_index.description: Options used only when method is mismatch_index.

max_mismatch.description: Substitutions tolerated between a read's feature segment and a tag.

tie_policy.description: Handling of reads matching two or more tags: unmapped, first in list order, or minimum distance.

read_model.description: hamming uses the index alone; quality_em adds a quality-aware likelihood with EM over tags.

citeseq_count.description: Options used only when method is citeseq_count.

max_errors.description: Hamming error tolerance applied to each tag prefix.

start_trim.description: Bases trimmed from the start of the feature read before matching.

bc_collapsing_dist.description: Maximum Hamming distance for merging a cell barcode into a whitelist entry.

umi_method.description: UMI graph rule used to collapse reads into molecules per cell and feature.

umi_threshold.description: Maximum Hamming distance between UMIs merged by umi_method; 2 matches the CITE-seq-Count default.

device.description: Execution device; auto uses CUDA only for batched tag lookup on large libraries.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without counting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing feature members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: counted and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example feature/layers/counts. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: n_reads, unmapped_fraction, ambiguous_fraction, tag_pairs_below_separation, flagged_variants, umi_collapsed_fraction.

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
